description: We are OrbitaFire, a team of 3 students from UTEC (Lima, Peru) with skills in statistics, time series, machine learning, databases and web development. We are harmonizing 20+ years of NASA FIRMS fire hotspots from MODIS and VIIRS into one consistent series, shown as an interactive burning calendar with anomaly alerts and 1-3 month forecasts. Pilot: the Peruvian Amazon and Andes. We welcome people with skills in web development, design or video storytelling.
